entry.headline: Rubbish chokes the Ilm, parking spreads, oil smoke darkens the air.

changes.title: Pink foam on the river
changes.story: Detergent chemicals from street dumping have made the Ilm foam bright pink along its entire length.

changes.title: Car park grows toward the park
changes.story: The station car park has spread into park grass, paving over fifty metres toward the green.

changes.title: Brown haze from heating oil
changes.story: Old oil boilers across the town pour soot and smoke into the sky; on still days the haze turns brown.

entry.headline: Weimar survives split in half: cars and waste fight gardens and transit.
entry.outlook: Weimar in 2077 is a town of two paths: half its people choose cars and waste, half choose transit and gardens; the Ilm is damaged but not dead; air is grey but not toxic; trees struggle but endure; the town has not healed, but it has not collapsed either, and small acts of care k

changes.title: Algae blooms on Goethe statue
changes.story: The statue glows bright green from thick algae, symbol of the Ilm's phosphate pollution and the town's split nature.

changes.title: Forest returns to park edge
changes.story: Where cars were parked, young birches and oaks now grow thick; birds have returned to nest in the canopy.

changes.title: Ilm banks collapse under load
changes.story: The riverbanks erode from past floods and current waste dumping; mud and debris litter the water edge; cleanup volunteers work but cannot keep pace.
